review_text: Inside Star Oil Station grounds. The cashier/lone staff out front seemed new and a bit slow but nice. Fabrew Cafe is the best touchdown I had for lunch just a few minutes away from the airport. I had an absolute treat for my tastebuds with the kinilaw, garlic butter shrimp, calamares and sotanghon. Capping the meal with a slice of blueberry cheesecake and hot tea! Each dish was a perfect balance of flavors, showcasing the care and expertise that went into every bite. A big shoutout to the excellent service crew and Chefs Mark and Jovien for preparing such an incredible meal. Hope to be back to explore more of their menu.

Fabrew Cafe and Bar Review Fabrew blends a cozy cafe ambiance with a lively bar vibe. During the day, it’s perfect for working or casual meetups, offering quality coffee and a relaxed atmosphere. At night, it transforms into a vibrant spot with creative cocktails and a solid selection of beers. The food is fresh, locally sourced, and pairs well with drinks. Friendly, knowledgeable staff and reasonable pricing make Fabrew a versatile spot for both coffee lovers and night owls. Whether you want a quiet afternoon or a fun night out, Fabrew hits the mark.

Fabrew café & bar is a must to visit. We really enjoyed the food here, super worthit po talaga. The ambience of the place is beautiful, the staff is super nice and friendly. Fabrew Cafe & Bar is a hidden gem in the city, perfect for a casual lunch, dinner, or night out. With a diverse menu, creative craft brews, and a cozy atmosphere, it offers a unique dining experience. The focus on sustainability and local ingredients adds to its appeal. While prices are on the higher side, the quality of food and drinks make it a worthwhile visit.
